_about.what: Every graphic-style parameter of the Snow 3D models, extracted from the Blender chat's shared Python library as delivered in source/assets/<pack>/src/. Each value: {value, src}. src = file:function (line). Paths are relative to source/assets/forest_start/src/ unless a pack is named.

newest_versions.value: Shared libs are byte-identical in every pack from 21.10 to 26.10 (forest_start 25.10, forest_rocks/trash/devices/gear/parts 25.10, forest_world 26.10 = newest pack). Newest copies: psxlib.py md5 bddca1ab, psxbake.py 75c7f54b, gen_kit.py b0d80eac, gen_tex.py f18b585b, gen_paint.py 958917d0, noise.py bc863107, pxfont.py 62bdce81, van2_kit.py b1b0aa22, van2_tex.py ed95cd81, van3_mech.py a0bc1d2c; bld_common.py 046371c4 (forest_fences / forest_items, has ncol), uvpack.py 32726e1b (forest_base), unwrap_fast.py 5799e19f, post_bloom.py 54dd87f3. Older copies only in generator_shed (18.10), forest_yard/generator_container/forest_hut (19.10), forest_garage (20.10).

blender.value: Blender 5.0.1 as a Python 3.11 module (bpy), scripts run with python3 -I <script>; numpy, scipy, PIL

core_idea.value: Models are built 100% from code (no input meshes): bmesh faces carry a float 'zone' id; each atlas group is unwrapped, world position / normal / zone / AO are baked per texel with Cycles, a numpy painter paints linear colour + grooves from those, then the PSX step (AO in the colour, 1-texel dark grooves, 64-colour k-means palette, Bayer 4x4 dither, point filter). The 'Utility Plane' recipe.

project_pixel_ppm.note: the generator shed's building atlas density = 'the project's pixel'; used as ppm_cap for every building / large structure / car / rock cliff
project_pixel_ppm.src: start_build.py:SHED_PPM (l.27); forest_hut/hut_build.py, forest_kpp/kpp_build.py, forest_yard/yard_build.py, forest_main/main_build.py, forest_rocks/rocks_build.py, forest_world/world_build.py:WORLD_PPM; bld_common.py:SHED_PPM

value.buildings_structures_vehicles_cliffs: 51.3 cap (achieved 44-51.3; big lattice / dish atlases fall to 25-35)
value.signs / panels (explicit UV): panel atlas tiles: start sign 160x104 px on 0.52x0.34 m = ~307 px/m

ppm_by_asset_class.src: start_build.py:make_atlas (l.124-130); forest_devices/devices_build.py:DESK_PPM, BOX_PPM (l.31); forest_gear/gear_build.py:SMALL_PPM, HAUL_PPM (l.29); forest_parts/parts_build.py:PARTS_PPM (l.29); snow_kit/snowkit_build.py:PPM (l.32); forest_trash/trash_build.py (l.88); forest_items/items_build.py:SPEC (l.108); generator_shed/gen_build.py (l.80-87); achieved values from */<pack>.json 'atlases'

ppm_cap_rule.value: if the atlas would come out finer than ppm_cap, all UV islands are scaled by k = cap / (size*sqrt(fill/area)) and the rest of the atlas stays empty: never finer than the project's pixel

zone_scale.value: per-zone UV scale factor before packing: hidden / underside faces 0.6-0.8 (roof 0.75, car underside 0.6, liner / carpet 0.8, pad 0.75, buried rock faces small); faces seen up close 2.0 (trash clumps)

atlas_sizes.src: start_build.py (l.124); start_tex.py:N (l.16); gen_tex.py:N (l.17); van2_tex.py:GN, LN (l.16, 23); forest_base/kpp_tex.py:CHAIN_N, BARB_W (l.42-43)

auto_size_bld_common.value: smallest power of two (256 up to max 2048) with size*sqrt(0.70/area) >= 0.90*cap; one more doubling if the real fill misses 0.90*cap; then shrink to cap

oversample.value: bake at 2x the atlas size (psxbake / bld_common), 4x for imported models (psxlib); each output texel = mean of the covered sub-samples

texture_files.value: T_<Pack>_<Atlas>_BaseColor.png (RGB, sRGB uint8, no alpha); T_<Pack>_Panel_BaseColor.png + T_<Pack>_Panel_Emission.png; <pack>_panel_regions.json (size, regions px x0,y0,x1,y1 origin top-left); no normal / roughness / metal maps

filtering.value: Closest (point) on every image node in Blender; Unity: FilterMode.Point, no mipmaps, Uncompressed, sRGB, Clamp, NPOT none

padding.value: texels outside the islands take the colour of the nearest covered texel (scipy distance_transform_edt) - no mip / filter bleeding; Cycles bake margin 0 for data passes, 4 for psxlib colour bakes
padding.src: psxbake.py:psx_step (l.134-136); psxlib.py:psx_quantize (l.482-484); psxbake.py:bake_pass margin=0 (l.74); psxlib.py:bake margin=4 (l.395)

baked_texel_mask.value: only sub-samples the bake really reached are painted: |len(decoded normal)-1| < 0.1 (an unbaked texel decodes to (-1,-1,-1)); stops dark teeth on oblique island borders

position_bake_range.value: POS_SCALE 8 (objects within +-4 m), forest_start sets 40 (+-20 m); position stored as pos/POS_SCALE+0.5, normal as n*0.5+0.5, zone as zone/32 in float images

colours_per_atlas.exceptions: forest_items Props 128 ('84 colourful things'); Snow atlases 24 (achieved 16-18)
colours_per_atlas.src: psxbake.py:psx_step ncol=64 (l.101); forest_items/items_build.py:SPEC ncol=128 (l.108); generator_shed/gen_build.py ncol=24 (l.87)

method.value: k-means in sRGB space (after linear->sRGB), 18 iterations, seed 0, centres initialised from random samples; trained on up to 60000 random covered texels (rng seed 1); one palette per atlas (no global palette)

priority_zones.value: prio_zones: texels of small vivid parts (trims, tail / head lamps, chrome, red knobs, battery terminals) get 6000 extra samples x3 weight so they claim their own clusters

assignment.value: nearest palette colour (squared RGB distance in sRGB) after adding the dither offset; done in chunks of 65536

colour_space.value: painters work in linear (lin(r,g,b) = sRGB 0-255 -> linear); quantize in sRGB; output PNG sRGB uint8 (q*255+0.5)

amplitude.value: (bayer-0.5) * (1/24) * dither, dither = 1.0: one step of the PS1 5-bit frame buffer, added in sRGB before the palette pick

tiling.value: Bayer tiled in atlas texel space (not screen space)

panel_tiles.value: hand-drawn panel / lens / glow tiles quantise gradients to a few levels with the same Bayer: floor(b*levels + bayer)/levels; bulkhead lens 7 levels, flood glass 8 / 9 levels, glow halo 10 levels, van lenses 8 grey steps

repo_tool_option.value: tools/psx_texture_tool.py offers --dither-mode two (Bayer between the two nearest palette colours, flat areas stay flat) for surfaces seen up close; the Blender library itself always uses the single-offset mode

method.value: Cycles AO bake (CPU, 40 samples) on the whole group at its final placement, at 2x atlas resolution; world.light_settings.distance = ao_dist

ao_min_and_distance_by_class.rule: ao_dist scales with the object: ~0.4 m for buildings, a few cm for hand things
ao_min_and_distance_by_class.src: start_build.py (l.124-130); forest_rocks/rocks_build.py (l.95); forest_world/world_build.py (l.149-157); forest_gear/gear_build.py (l.129-133); forest_devices/devices_build.py (l.134-138); forest_parts/parts_build.py (l.129-133); forest_trash/trash_build.py (l.88); forest_items/items_build.py (l.108); generator_shed/gen_build.py (l.80-87)

groove_lines.value: AO-derived 1-texel dark lines: line = clip((mean AO of covered sub-samples - min AO) * 2.4, 0, 0.5); colour *= (1-line); none on island borders

groove_lines_psxlib.value: imported-model path: line = clip((block mean AO - 12th percentile) * 2.6, 0, 0.55)

painted_grooves.value: painters return groove[n] 0..1 for panel lines / seams (noise.groove: 1 - smoothstep(w/2-aa, w/2+aa, d), aa = texel size in metres); typical widths 3-10 mm, weights 0.25-0.8; multiplied into colour by 0.55

cavity_edge_masks.value: cav = smoothstep(0.62, 0.30, ao) (dirt in corners); edge = smoothstep(0.86, 0.97, ao) * smoothstep(0.70, 0.88, fbm(P, 60, 2)) (worn convex edges)

painted_light.value: natural surfaces (rocks, trash, world fixtures) additionally: colour *= 0.93 + 0.12*up - 0.12*down (tops lighter, undersides darker)

noise_basis.value: 3D Perlin fbm on world position: fbm(p, freq, octaves=3, gain=0.5, lacunarity 2.03), result 0.5 + 1.1*sum/norm clipped 0..1; 12 fixed noise seeds; ss = smoothstep(e0, e1, x) (e0 > e1 inverts)

dirt_in_corners.value: mixc(c, dark of the material, cav * 0.35-0.6) on every material

edge_wear.value: paint edges to bare / dark: mixc(c, base metal or dark, edge * 0.5-0.9); steel edges to RUST: edge*0.7-0.8 + spots ss(0.66-0.72, 0.84-0.86, fbm(30)) * 0.5-0.6, capped 0.8-0.9

needles_and_leaves_on_top.value: _litter: mask = (ss(0.52,0.72,fbm(P,5,3))*0.7 + ss(0.62,0.80,fbm(P,30,1))*0.6) * up * amount; per-cell colour pick (cells 1/53 x 1/47 m): >0.70 LEAF lin(150,96,44), >0.35 NEEDLE_A lin(132,92,46), else NEEDLE_B lin(96,70,40); applied at 0.85-0.95; roof troughs and car scuttle get heavy mats (needles + dark tide marks lin(70,62,52))

moss_near_ground_and_joints.value: MOSS lin(70,86,40), MOSS_D lin(46,58,30), MOSS_L lin(98,112,54): at the wall foot ss(0.40, 0.02, z_above_floor)*ss(0.45,0.70,fbm(12))*0.8; on concrete ss(0.55,0.78,fbm(9))*(0.4+0.6*cav)*0.65; rocks: tops ss(0.45,0.80,up), foot ss(0.40,0.02,z), joints ss(0.58,0.32,ao)*0.7, times per-kind factor 0.55-1.0

streaks.value: vertical runs: streak = ss(0.55, 0.80, fbm(P*(1,1,0.12), 6, 3)) mixed at 0.25-0.45 (darker shade of the paint); roof rust runs ss(0.52-0.58, 0.78-0.82, fbm(P*(1,0.15,0.15), 7, 3)) * 0.75-0.85 (RUST), underside 0.45 (RUST_D); rock water streaks fbm stretch z 0.13, ss(0.60,0.74) * steepness * 0.45

weathered_paint.value: faces to the weather fade: weather = 1.0 (normal -y), 0.7 (+x), 0.45 others; mixc(c, FADE, weather*ss(0.30,0.70,n_lo)*0.45); flaked to bare grey wood low down: ss(0.58-0.62, 0.80-0.82, fbm(P*(1,1,0.3),14,3)) * (0.35+0.65*ss(0.6-0.7, 0.10-0.15, z))

rust_at_fasteners_and_edges.value: sign screws: 3x3 screw, rust pixels (120,64,30) at 0.45 below each screw; car rust at arches / sills / tailgate masked by fbm(22) + bubbles ss(0.80,0.90,fbm(55)); drum rims rust (dark rust lin(70,50,38) on blue paint: 'no purple')

oil_and_grime.value: OIL lin(28,23,18) drips ss(0.58,0.78,fbm(P*(1,1,0.25),9,3)) below z 0.75-1.05 at 0.7 and gaussian puddles under valves / pumps; GRIME lin(64,58,48)

trodden_paths.value: gaussian path from the door across floors, mud lin(78,66-72,52-62) at 0.45-0.55

decal_ageing.value: panel signs: _age = 18-70 random pixels blended 0.18-0.25 towards (110-120, 80-100, 50-70); 260 chipped pixels along the 3 px border towards (86,62,44) at 0.6

snow_material.value: snow (236,240,248) * (0.94+0.06 fbm(6)), blue in the AO lin(150,170,200) by ss(0.8,0.3,ao)*0.6, sparkle to white ss(0.86,0.95,fbm(70))*0.5; snow meshes are separate objects with blend shape 'Clear' (100 = no snow), hidden by default

draft_colours.value: every pack keeps DRAFT_COL {zone: sRGB} = the painters' base colours for --draft builds (flat zone materials, roughness 0.75)

atlas_material_blender.value: Principled BSDF; Base Color = image (interpolation Closest) through a UV Map node 'PSX'; Roughness 0.8 default (buildings 0.85, props 0.7-0.8, hand things 0.55-0.6, rocks 0.9); Metallic 0; Specular IOR Level 0.25; no normal / roughness maps

flatten_bsdf.value: imported models: Coat, Sheen, Transmission, Anisotropic, Subsurface = 0, Specular IOR Level 0.3 ('PS1 surfaces are plain diffuse with a weak highlight')

panel_and_lens_material.value: tex_mat(name, base, emission, night_emit): Base Color + Emission Color images (Closest, UV 'PSX'), Emission Strength 0 in the file, custom prop night_emit = strength when lit; roughness 0.35 default (panel 0.55-0.6, lenses 0.2); Specular IOR Level 0.35

glow_material.value: M_<Pack>_Glow: Emission (panel emission image, Closest) + Transparent BSDF via Add Shader, strength 0 in the file, night_emit 2.0, custom prop blend='additive', surface_render_method BLENDED, object visible_shadow False

glass_material.value: psx_glass: flat tint, Roughness 0.5, Specular 0.12, Alpha 0.42 default, BLENDED; optional warm glow (1.0,0.62,0.30). Tints used: booth (0.12,0.13,0.12) a0.45; dirty car (0.17,0.16,0.13) a0.62; world cars (0.34,0.38,0.36) a0.55; devices (0.10,0.10,0.11) a0.50; main clear (0.10,0.12,0.13) a0.30, dark (0.02,0.022,0.025) a0.85; sodium lamp glass (0.80,0.82,0.80) a0.22

cutouts.value: chain-link / barbed / razor: alpha cut-out 0.5, tiled 0.5 m; fences: one-sided, each quad as two faces 2.4 mm apart facing out, mips with Preserve Coverage

material_names.value: M_<Pack>_<Atlas> (baked), M_<Pack>_Panel, M_<Pack>_Lamp_<Kind> + M_<Pack>_Lamp_<Kind>_Off (off variants use_fake_user), M_<Pack>_Glow, M_<Pack>_Glass / _GlassDirty; packs replacing Update 3 objects keep Update 3's named materials (M_Lamp_SodiumOff, M_LEDOff, M_ScreenOff, M_GlassDirty ...) because the game swaps them by name

value.atlas / panel / lens: URP/Lit, Specular workflow flag 1, Opaque, _BaseMap = atlas, _BaseColor white, _Smoothness 0, _Metallic 0, no normal map, _SPECULARHIGHLIGHTS_OFF, _ENVIRONMENTREFLECTIONS_OFF, cull back, receive shadows; emissive: _EMISSION on, _EmissionColor = (emit,emit,emit).gamma, _EmissionMap = panel emission, RealtimeEmissive, ShadowCaster pass off
value.glass: URP/Lit transparent, SrcAlpha/OneMinusSrcAlpha, ZWrite 0, Cull off, no shadows
value.glow: URP/Unlit, Surface transparent, Blend additive (SrcAlpha/One), ZWrite 0, Cull off, queue Transparent+10, _BaseColor = gain

building_sign_glow.value: building packs' sign panels are lit: emission = albedo at 0.06 (retroreflective, Update 3's M_ObsSigns); prop packs' panels 0.0

light_mask.value: lightMask per object = 1 << room layer (Exterior layer 1 -> 2); building packs write it per part

construction.value: procedural bmesh via KB: poly, box / box_m, tube (parallel transport), cyl (optional taper r2), strip (rect section swept), lathe (profile revolved), loft (rings), slab (thin sheet), superdome (lens), quad_uv / disc_uv (explicit-UV faces). Every face gets float 'zone'; explicit-UV faces use zone ZERO=0.0

bevels.value: no Blender bevel modifier; edges modelled: rbox rounded edges r 0.01 m + chamfered ends 0.006 m; lamp bezels with chamfer 0.005; rrect corners; corrugation, boards, rivets, cracks, fins are texture only ('corrugation is in the texture')

shading_normals.value: hard-surface models flat-shaded (bmesh faces default flat, FBX mesh_smooth_type 'FACE', Unity importNormals Import); exceptions: rocks smooth + set_sharp_from_angle 38 deg; cave rock faces smooth ('the AO and the light follow the rock, not its facets')

orientation.value: faces wound by an 'out' vector (Newell normal); box6 sorts lo/hi; obox flips a left-handed frame; lens objects face out by majority vote; Unity culls back faces so every lit face must face the viewer

ngons.value: faces with more than 4 verts triangulated (BEAUTY / BEAUTY)

welding.value: remove_doubles dist 1e-4 m on every non-joined KB (except no_weld zones)

coplanar.value: overlapping same-facing coplanar faces (normal dot > 0.999, plane within 1 mm) are lifted 0.8 mm per layer, largest face stays

decal_offsets.value: sign / plate quads 3 mm off the wall; lens quads 1 mm proud of the housing face (housing face +2 mm); halo cards 1-4.5 cm in front of the lens

glass.value: each pane twice back to back (or two faces 1 mm apart): glass is seen from both sides

detail_rule.value: everything a real object has that opens, moves or comes off is its own object with its pivot at the hinge / axis; lamps: housing with bevelled bezel and gasket, lens with a crown or dome (never a flat sticker), a mount for every lamp, one lens object per lamp

tri_counts_observed.note: no explicit budget in code; these are the delivered numbers

units_ground.value: metres; origin on the ground z = 0; foot of terrain props sinks into the ground (rocks BURY, booth pad 0.30 m below ground)

uv_map.value: single UV map named 'PSX'; every other UV map removed before save; active + active_render

unwrap.value: Smart UV Project, angle 62 deg (psxbake), 50 (bld_common), 60 (psxlib); area_weight 0, correct_aspect, no scale_to_bounds; yard tanks 30, trafo 40

pack.value: pack_islands rotate ANY, scale, CONCAVE shape, margin FRACTION; bld_common additionally shelf-repacks island bounding boxes (uvpack.repack, margin 2.2 px) and keeps the better fill; unwrap_fast uses AXIS_ALIGNED + AABB for thousands of islands

padding_margin.value: ~2 texels between islands: margin = max(0.002, 2.2/size) with a ppm_cap (1.5/size without); margin_px for many thin islands (yard trafo 1.8)

texel_uniformity.value: uniform texel density inside an atlas (smart project with area-proportional packing); deliberate exceptions only via zone_scale

explicit_uv_regions.value: panel / lens / glow faces get explicit UVs from pixel rects with a half-texel inset: u0 = (x0+0.5)/n, v0 = 1-(y1-0.5)/n, u1 = (x1-0.5)/n, v1 = 1-(y0+0.5)/n; lathe lenses use cylindrical UVs within 0.05..0.95 of the rect width

pixel_snapping.value: no UV pixel snapping in the bake path (islands at fractional positions); hard pixel edges come from point filter + 2x oversample averaging; panel art itself is drawn on integer pixels

value.<Root>: prefab root (StartBooth, StartCar ...), origin on the ground
value.IX_<Name>: interactable that moves (doors, lids, hatches); no numbers in prop packs - Unity numbers them on placement; building packs keep Update 3's numbers (IX_HatchLid_94)
value.COL_<Name>: BoxCollider reference (collection Colliders, hidden, not in FBX)
value.LIGHT_<Name>: empty: +Z = beam, +Y = up (Unity light frame); light comes from the lights json
value.Lamp_<Name>: lamp housing part (parent of lens and glow)
value.Glow_<Name>: additive halo card, shown when lit
value.Item_<Name>: carried thing (catalogue key); its parts / sockets start with the name without Item_
value.Snow_<Name>: snow overlay with blend shape Clear

part_kinds.meaning: hinge = rotate about axis through pivot; twist = rotate then may come off; slide = along axis in metres; item = carried; spin = free rotation; stretch / scale = scale along axis

blender_frame.value: each root in its own frame: z up, the front -y, metres, origin on the ground (z = 0) at the middle of its footprint

to_unity.value: position / axis (x, y, z) -> Unity (-x, z, -y); angle -> -angle (Unity left-handed); box size (sx, sy, sz) -> (sx, sz, sy); the root's front (-y) becomes the prefab's +Z; rotationUnity = (rx, -rz, ry)

hinge_sign.value: hinge axes right-handed, +angle opens; tools/kit/make_unity_data.py negates hinge axes for SkyIslandInteractable (turns by +angle); slides and spins keep the converted axis

object_origin.value: every object's origin = its contract pivot (mesh translated by -pivot, location = pivot); parents attached keeping world transforms

display_offset.value: in the .blend the roots stand apart (DISPLAY offsets); the contract gives everything in each root's own frame; FBX exported with the root at the origin

vehicle_frame_legacy.value: van / imported vehicles: x forward, y left, z up (psxlib.normalise bakes transforms, ground z = 0)

value.tool: tools/forest_start/export_fbx.py (repo side; the Blender chat delivers .blend only)
value.selection: per root: root + descendant meshes, COL_ and LIGHT_ left out, deeper meshes lifted to direct children of the root, Lens_ / Glow_ kept as separate objects, door glass joined into its door

unity_import.value: ModelImporter globalScale 1, useFileScale, importNormals Import, importTangents None, no colliders / animation / cameras / lights, materials remapped to the builder's URP materials

blend_cleanup_before_save.value: only the PSX UV map left; 'zone' attribute removed (kept in --draft); COL_ hidden; images relinked to //tex/<name> relative paths; no linked libraries

value.parts: {name: {kind, pivot, axis, range, unit ('deg' | 'm'), rest, parent, states[], note, object, root, box{center,size} (moving parts), pivotUnity, axisUnity, + optional links{from,ratio}, blendshape, default, locked, removable, mass_kg, lightMask, materials, lamp_kind}}
value.sockets: {name: {pos, kind, parent, root, note, dir, posUnity, dirUnity, + optional up, item, eye, facing}}
value.colliders: [{name COL_*, parent, root, type 'box', center, size (parent frame), center_root, centerUnity, sizeUnity, rotation, rotationUnity}]
value.meta: {version, units 'metres, degrees', frame, unity, display_offset, colliders, lamps, model, textures, materials, ix, names, hierarchy, light_layers, mass}

every_object_has_entry.value: build asserts every KB has a contract part

lights_json.value: {note, lights:[{socket LIGHT_*, root, lens, glow, parent, type, unityLight Point|Spot, position, forward, up, positionUnity, forwardUnity, upUnity, intensityURP, kelvin, colorLinear, range, group, shadows false, desc, startsOn false, spotAngle}]}

stats_json.value: <pack>.json: atlases {size, ppm, area_m2, uv_fill, colours}, tris, tris_by_root, objects, display_offset, contract counts

doc.value: <PACK>_CONTRACT.md in Russian (copied to docs/gdd/), version + date, coordinates given in Unity values

value.F35: 3x5 px glyphs, advance 4 (M N W are 5 wide), smallest legible

fonts.rules: hand-made bitmap fonts, capitals + digits + signs only (text upper-cased), 1 px spacing, integer scale (scale=2 for headings), hard edges - no anti-aliasing anywhere, positions rounded to whole pixels

umlauts.value: Ä Ö Ü patched into both fonts at import (the two dots replace the glyph's top row); lower-case k, m, t patched for 'km', '7,5 t'

language_rule.value: wall signs: German first (larger, F57, often scale 2), English under it (F35 or F57); equipment labels in English; goods and the guards' / forester's own papers in German

sign_example_start.value: ZUFAHRT (F57 x2, INK) / SPERRGEBIET (F57 x2, RED) / grey rule / RESTRICTED AREA / ACCESS (F57 x1, INK) / UNBEFUGTEN ZUTRITT VERBOTEN (F35, RED_D); white enamel (236,232,220), 3 px red border inset 2 px, 4 screws with rust, chipped edges; 160x104 px on a 0.52x0.34 m plate

plates.value: _plate: fill + 1 px light frame + 1 px dark bottom / right edge (bevel look)

gauges.value: dial(): hard-edged ticks, F35 numerals, coloured arcs, title below the hub, sweep -120..120 (small gauges -60..60); emission map = night backlight

panel_layout.value: panel atlas background (16,16,16); REG dict of pixel rects; panel-local metres -> pixels so printed labels sit where the 3D controls are

structure.value: Lamp_<X> (housing, static, in the atlas) > Lens_<X> (explicit-UV lens on the panel atlas, own material lit / _Off) + Glow_<X> (additive halo cards, unlit, no shadow) + LIGHT_<X> empty

lens_tiles.value: base colour = dark version of the lit look (bulkhead tile * 0.50, shed 0.55; indicator off = lit*0.38 with a 0.6 highlight disc), emission map = lit look; radial falloff 1-0.55r quantised with Bayer; cage bars as 1 px dark columns every 8 px (base (40,40,40), emission (60,58,50)); flood glass: prism ribs every 4 px, halogen tube line

glow_tiles.value: emission only, base black; g = (1-r)^1.6 quantised to 10 levels with Bayer, cut at r > 0.97; cards 0.5x0.5 m (bulkhead) + a 0.32x0.5 m card under the eave, 0.80x0.56 m (flood)

value.in the file: all off (Emission Strength 0, _Off materials kept with fake user)
